messages:
jess_support: Hi @customer_alex — saw your ticket about bundles stalling after redaction. Can you confirm the collector version and send the request_id from the failed upload?
customer_alex: Running 0.9.12 (private). Upload logs show: request_id=01H7ZQ8B6XKJ3, error="upload failed: invalid-content-length". Bundle size ~48MB.
jess_support: Thanks. Any redaction logs? grep for "redact" or "timeout" in /var/log/collector.log.
customer_alex: Here —
```
2026-03-10T22:11:09Z INFO redact:start files=324
2026-03-10T22:11:45Z WARN redact:timeout file=/tmp/bundle/segment-17.json dur=36s
2026-03-10T22:12:00Z ERROR upload:presign manifest_mismatch signed_manifest=eyJ... request_id=01H7ZQ8B6XKJ3
```
aj_oncall: Looks like redaction timeout + then a presign manifest mismatch. Could be collector computed content-length before redaction changed size. Can you try re-running collector with --no-redact to repro upload? If it succeeds, we'll know redaction step is the cause.
customer_alex: Trying now. If I need to preserve PII, can you give an inbound SFTP fallback?
mike_devops: We can spin up a temporary SFTP endpoint. But first try curl repro of the presigned PUT to confirm server rejects content-length. Here's a typical curl we use:
```
curl -v -X PUT "<PRESIGNED_URL>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \
  -H "Content-Length: 50483200" \
  --data-binary @bundle.tar.gz
```
collector-bot: DEBUG BUNDLE CREATED: /var/tmp/debug-01H7ZQ8B6XKJ3.tgz (size=48603200) — upload_attempts=1
customer_alex: Repro with --no-redact succeeded (PUT returned 200). So redaction likely shrank size but presign expected larger size.
jess_support: OK that matches. Two paths: regenerate presign after redaction (preferred) or make collector upload use chunked transfer to avoid Content-Length requirement. For now, can you run collector with `--regenerate-presign-after-redact` flag and attach new debug bundle?
customer_alex: Ran with flag, got new presign and upload 200. Uploaded debug bundle to s3://private-debug/01H7ZQ8B6XKJ3.tgz. Sharing presigned manifest: s3://private-debug/01H7ZQ8B6XKJ3.manifest.json
aj_oncall: Thanks. Can you also paste the collector config (trim secrets) — specifically presign flow and redaction concurrency?
customer_alex: Config snippet:
```
presign:
  require_content_length: true
redaction:
  timeout_seconds: 30
  concurrency: 2
```
mike_devops: If require_content_length=true we should either set to false for chunked uploads or update presign logic to compute post-redaction length. Filing bug: INF-4927.
jess_support: Filed INF-4927, assigned @aj_oncall. For now recommend customers upgrade to collector 0.9.13 (hotfix) with presign/regenerate option. I'll follow up in ticket. :thumbsup:
